why: I checked both briefs against must_not item 1, which bans PASS/FAIL conditions stricter than the issue's lines. The verifier brief breaks it in three places. Item 6 makes the branch name a pass/fail check: "branch name matches CLAUDE.md convention (<type>/<issue>-<slug>, no claude/ prefix, under 60 chars)". It also limits which files the PR may touch: "the diff is limited to this tool plus README/lock changes". Item 4 asks for a mutation test: "mutate lint() ... confirm a test would fail, then revert". The issue's lines ask for none of these. The builder brief also states the branch-name rule as a requirement ("Branch name must match"), though its done-checks leave it out. Its done-checks run the CLI rather than reading the diff, so must_not item 2 holds there. The breaches of item 1 are enough to fail.
